description: This file contains setup and configuration logic for Slack integration within a larger application, including credential handling, account setup wizard creation, and Slack-specific policies.

methods.name: enableSlackAccount
methods.description: Enables Slack account configuration by patching the channel config to enabled.

methods.name: hasSlackInteractiveRepliesConfig
methods.description: Checks if the Slack account has the 'interactiveReplies' capability enabled.

methods.name: setSlackInteractiveReplies
methods.description: Sets or unsets the 'interactiveReplies' capability for a Slack account.

methods.name: createSlackTokenCredential
methods.description: Creates credential configuration objects for Slack bot and app tokens.
